guarantees.claim: Each cipher control FSM instance (positive edge when SP2V_LOGIC_HIGH[i]==1, negative edge when ==0) is monitored by an AesCipherControlFsmCheck_A instance that drives alert_tx_o[1] on FSM error.

assumptions.claim: SP2V_LOGIC_HIGH[i] must correctly reflect whether FSM instance i is positive-edge triggered; 1 for positive edge, 0 for negative edge.
assumptions.risk: Checker instantiates for the inactive edge, so FSM errors will not be monitored, and alert_tx_o[1] may never trigger for real errors.

uncertain_points.claim: All AesCipherControlFsmCheck_A instances in this generate loop connect their alert outputs directly to the same net alert_tx_o[1] without visible OR-combining logic.
uncertain_points.cond: multiple instances trying to drive alert_tx_o[1] simultaneously
uncertain_points.risk: Contention or resolution ambiguity may prevent correct assertion of the alert, undermining security/error signalling.
